norm_text: the contract or other arrangement required by § 164.308(b) must meet the applicable requirements of this section.

title: Business associate contracts—Elements
clause_text: Provide that the business associate will implement administrative, physical, and technical safeguards that reasonably and appropriately protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the electronic protected health information that it creates, receives, maintains, or transmits on behalf of the covered entity, as required by this subpart.
norm_text: provide that the business associate will implement administrative, physical, and technical safeguards that reasonably and appropriately protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the electronic protected health information that it creates, receives, maintains, or transmits on behalf of the covered entity, as required by this subpart.

title: Business associate contracts—Reporting and termination
clause_text: Provide that the business associate will report to the covered entity any security incident of which it becomes aware, and authorize termination if the covered entity determines that the business associate has violated a material term.
norm_text: provide that the business associate will report to the covered entity any security incident of which it becomes aware, and authorize termination if the covered entity determines that the business associate has violated a material term.

title: Implementation specifications for group health plans
clause_text: Plan documents must be amended to incorporate provisions to ensure that the plan sponsor will implement administrative, physical, and technical safeguards that reasonably and appropriately protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the electronic protected health information that it creates, receives, maintains, or transmits on behalf of the group health plan.
norm_text: plan documents must be amended to incorporate provisions to ensure that the plan sponsor will implement administrative, physical, and technical safeguards that reasonably and appropriately protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the electronic protected health information that it creates, receives, maintains, or transmits on behalf of the group health plan.

title: Documentation
clause_text: Maintain the policies and procedures implemented to comply with this subpart in written (which may be electronic) form; and if an action, activity or assessment is required, document and retain it in written (which may be electronic) form.
